reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was $29.99 for 30 sachets, a dollar a serving, when my Nature Made or Double Wood runs 20 to 40 cents, and then that there are zero reviews. The sachets and the QR lab report are nice for travel, but I read reviews for 20 minutes before I try anything new and there is nothing to read.
objection: A dollar a serving for a brand nobody has reviewed yet. I would be paying 3 to 5 times my usual price to be the guinea pig, and I can just put my regular capsules in a pill case for trips.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred real reviews with a good rating, and a price closer to 60 to 70 cents a serving, or a small trial box (5 to 7 sachets) for under $10 to test on a trip before committing.
